caseNameFull: Sanchez-Llamas v. Oregon Bustillo v. Johnson, Director, Virginia Department of Corrections

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Ore.; and Sup. Ct. Va. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 1001.] Motion of petitioner Moises Sanchez-Llamas for appointment of counsel granted. Peter Gartlan, Esq., of Salem, Ore., is appointed to serve as counsel for petitioner Sanchez-Llamas in this case. Motion of petitioners to dispense with printing the joint appendix granted.
